description: The woman wears an opaque deep reddish-brown noble gown with a low square neckline, fitted panelled bodice and elbow-length outer sleeves. Gold floral woven borders frame the neckline, bodice seams, sleeve edges, waist and long front skirt panels. Small round jewel-set clasps sit near the shoulders and on the decorative belt. A cream inner dress shows down the center of the floor-length skirt, and cream fabric drapes around her forearms beneath the outer sleeves. A fine gold necklace is visible. A dark leather shoe peeks beneath the hem. Her bobbed head remains uncovered.
